## PART 1 — GLOBAL

### Language & Communication
- **Code & comments**: English only
- **Chat responses**: Vietnamese if complex/long; English otherwise
- **Commit messages**: English, imperative (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`)
- **Dialogs**: `useSwal()` only. Never `window.alert()` / `window.confirm()`

### Dev Philosophy
- **Single developer**: no enterprise patterns, no team workflows
- **MVP-first**: ship skeleton, iterate. No "nice to have" until core works
- **DRY** — but don't abstract for abstraction's sake
- **YAGNI** — don't add features not currently needed
- **Fail loudly in dev, silently in prod** — use `import.meta.dev` guards
- **Security**: sanitize inputs; never expose secrets in client code

### AI assistant (AI AGENT) rules:
- **Scope**: Only do what is explicitly asked — no extra commits|pushes|refactors|improvements if not requested
- **Done = verified**: Never declare a task complete without checking compile/lint errors first

**Source of Truth Priority order:**
1. **Local source code** — `node_modules`, type defs, actual runtime/build output. Supersedes all docs and training data
2. **Official docs** — fetch via `fetch_webpage` (cite URL) or curl if fetch fails. Never rely on memory alone
3. **Live test result** — observed build|run|deploy output, with date

**Rules:**
- No speculation — every claim needs a source from the hierarchy above
- Cite explicitly: `(source: <url>)` or `(verified: <method> <date>)`
- If unverifiable right now, say so — do not state inference as fact

### Documentation
- All docs in `docs/<topic>/<name>.md`
- `docs/index.md` is the single master index — update whenever code changes
- Completed plans → `docs/plan/done/` — never delete
- `README.md` covers dev setup only; all detail lives in `docs/`

## PART 2 — NUXT 4 + CLOUDFLARE STACK

*Reusable across all Nuxt 4 + Cloudflare Pages projects.*

**Stack**: Nuxt 4 · Vue 3 · Tailwind v4 · @nuxtjs/i18n · @nuxtjs/seo · SweetAlert2 · FontAwesome 7.2 · aki-info-detect

### Cloudflare Worker Constraints
- No `fs`, `child_process`, `path` — Cloudflare Worker has no filesystem
- `fetch()` for outbound requests — not `http`/`https` modules
- `crypto.subtle` (Web Crypto API) — not Node native crypto
- No `nodejs_compat` flags in `wrangler.toml` — Nitro 2.x + unenv 2.x Proxy bug crashes Worker startup; re-enable after upstream fix

### ⚠️ CRITICAL — Preset & Build Output Directory (verified 2025-05-17)

**Use `cloudflare_pages` preset for Cloudflare Pages — not `cloudflare_module`:**
- `cloudflare_pages` = for Cloudflare Pages platform: static HTML on CDN + `_worker.js` in advanced mode
- `cloudflare_module` = Nitro's recommended preset for standalone Cloudflare Workers (not Pages)
- Source: [Nitro cloudflare docs](https://nitro.build/deploy/providers/cloudflare)

**Output directory is `dist/`** (source: live Cloudflare build log 2025-05-17 — not in Nitro docs):
- `wrangler.toml` must say `pages_build_output_dir = "dist"` — DO NOT change
- `dist/_worker.js` → Cloudflare Pages deploys in [advanced mode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/functions/advanced-mode/): handles all SSR requests, falls back to static assets via `env.ASSETS.fetch()`
- `dist/_routes.json` → auto-generated by Nitro: per-route rules CDN vs Worker
- Manual deploy: `npx wrangler pages deploy dist`
- Wrong value → build succeeds, deploy fails: "Output directory not found"

### Rendering Strategy
| Route type | Mode | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Public pages | SSG (pre-render) | Fast, CDN-served, SEO-ready |
| Dynamic content (`/posts/[slug]`, etc.) | SSR | Full HTML for bots/crawlers/AI; hydrate for real browsers |
| `/admin` | SPA (`ssr: false`, no-index, bot-blocked) | Private, no crawl needed |

Use `aki-info-detect` to distinguish bots from real user browsers → drive bot vs. hydration content strategy.

### Vue / Nuxt Patterns
- **SSR Guards**: entry points only (`onMounted`, top-level `typeof window !== 'undefined'`). Never scatter micro-guards — follow Vue's native lifecycle, not defensive guard patterns
- **Async**: wrap in `try/catch` inside composables
- **Template attribute order**: `id` → `v-for :key` → `v-if/show` → `v-model` → `@events` → `:bindings` → `class/static`
- **`v-for` always has `:key`** — stable IDs over array index
- **`v-if` / `v-show`**: `v-if` for conditional; `v-show` for toggle-heavy elements
- In Nuxt, prefer framework composables/APIs for runtime-provided state instead of inventing props or manual plumbing.
- No inline color styles unless CSS variables (e.g., `style="color: var(--color-cyan);"`)
- `NuxtLink` for internal links; `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">` for external

### i18n
- Keys: camelCase in locale JSON files
- UI text: page language inline; shared/repeated strings → i18n key
- Strategy: `prefix_except_default` — default locale has no URL prefix

### UI / Tailwind
- Desktop-first; never hardcode large spacing. Scale up from narrow: `p-2 md:p-4 lg:p-6` | Modal: `px-3 py-3 md:px-6 md:py-5` | Gap/text: `gap-2 md:gap-3`, `text-sm md:text-base`
- Icons: FontAwesome 7 Free; external links: `fa-arrow-up-right-from-square`; `aria-label` on icon-only elements; focus trap in modals via `useFocusTrap` (VueUse)

### SEO
- Every page: `usePageSeo()` + `useSchemaOrg()` (JSON-LD) + OG image (static file per page)
- See `docs/seo/page-creation-rules.md`
